CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(InvoiceTransactionStatus__c, "Draft"), ISPICKVAL(InvoiceTransactionStatus__c, "Cancelled"), ISBLANK(TEXT(InvoiceTransactionStatus__c)) ), "", IF( ISBLANK(PaymentScheduledDate__c), "予定日なし", IF( ISPICKVAL(CollectionRefundStatus__c, "Completed"), IF( PaymentClearingCompletedDate__c <= PaymentScheduledDate__c, "期限内完了", "遅れて完了" ), IF( TODAY() <= PaymentScheduledDate__c, "期間中", "遅延" ) ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: 入金予定日基準。期間中／遅延／期限内完了／遅れて完了／予定日なし
CustomField.label: 期限状態
